verdicts.reason: The two banners are nearly identical, and both have the same faults. The quote is tiny serif text that is hard to read at 320x50, while the gold 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' attribution is about as large as the quote and crammed against the bottom-left edge, so the hierarchy is inverted. The jar is shrunk to an unreadable orange sliver at the right edge, and the SOLSTICE logo is missing (B has only a stray, unreadable speck near 'too soon'), so the brand does not survive.
